verdict.rationale: Mistral's OCR produces LLM-friendly output. Community users report strong PDF-to-markdown results, and tables can be emitted as markdown or html. The `extract_header`/`extract_footer` parameters route page furniture into separate `header` and `footer` fields, `include_blocks` gives labeled structural blocks in reading order, and `document_annotation` returns structured JSON. One hands-on report notes a whole page being returned as an image placeholder instead of text. Missing for 10: explicit docs confirming headers/footers are removed from the main markdown body, handling of repeated cross-page furniture or other page noise (page numbers, watermarks), independent corroboration of clean-output quality.
